Our Process for Air Duct Cleaning in Colina del Sol, CA

Curious what actually happens during a proper duct cleaning? Here is how we do it.

1) Inspection and Setup

We start with a visual check of your supply and return ducts, your indoor unit, and registers. We look for heavy dust, debris, damaged flex lines, gaps, or any signs of moisture. We protect floors and furniture, then set up negative air machines with HEPA filtration to capture particles as we work.

2) Source Removal Cleaning

We connect our vacuum equipment to the trunk line and use rotary brushes and compressed air whips to dislodge buildup. We clean each supply run and the main return lines. Grilles and registers are removed and cleaned too. The dust goes straight into sealed filtration, not back into your home.

3) Coil and Blower Area Attention

If your evaporator coil face and blower wheel are accessible and dirty, we can clean them. Cleaner coils improve efficiency and can help your home cool and heat more evenly.

4) Ductwork Sanitizing by Request

If odors or microbes are a concern, we can apply a duct sanitizer approved for occupied spaces. This step helps with musty smells and light bacterial growth. It is not a scent bomb, and it leaves no heavy perfume.

5) Final Check and Photos

We finish with a final walkthrough, reattach and seal access points, and verify airflow. We can show before and after photos so you can see what came out.

Why Colina del Sol Homes Often Need Duct Attention

Many homes in Colina del Sol have a mix of older ductwork and newer equipment. We often find.

  • Loose or unsealed connections at plenums and boots
  • Kinked flex runs that starve airflow to a back bedroom
  • Dirty coils that cut efficiency and comfort
  • Return ducts undersized for a modern high efficiency system
  • Attics with minimal insulation that heat up fast

Fixing these issues can make a big difference. You should not have to run your AC full blast just to cool the living room while bedrooms stay warm.

How Often Should You Schedule Air Duct Cleaning?

Average homes do well with cleaning every 3 to 5 years. Consider sooner if you.

  • Have pets, indoor smoking, or heavy cooking
  • Live near high traffic streets like University Avenue or El Cajon Boulevard
  • Just completed renovations
  • Have family members with asthma or allergies

If your filters clog fast or your vents smell musty, you will benefit from sooner rather than later. We can check and give you a sensible timeline.

Dryer Vent Cleaning for Fire Safety and Faster Drying

Lint buildup in the dryer vent is common in apartments and single-family homes, especially where the vent run is long or has many turns. Signs you need cleaning.

  • Clothes take more than one cycle to dry
  • The dryer or laundry room feels hotter than normal
  • A burning or dusty smell when the dryer runs
  • Visible lint around the outdoor vent hood

We clear the line, clean the hood, and check airflow. If your vent run is long, a booster fan can help keep air moving and cut dry times. Consider booster fan installation.
